sloka: समन्तात् विप्रधावद्भिः प्रकाशन्ते मम अन्यदा ।तानि अद्य अनुरुदन्ति इव परित्यक्तानि कामिभिः ॥२-७१-२३॥
transliteration: samantāt vipradhāvadbhiḥ prakāśante mama anyadā ।tāni adya anurudanti iva parityaktāni kāmibhiḥ ॥2-71-23॥

translations.english: ﻿ O charioteer, people full of passion have abandoned the gardens. To me, the city looks like a forest as if weeping.
